question: Should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets be allowed, and what redaction, scope, retention, export, and command-binding boundary must they follow?
rationale: The request is plausible and useful, but it would surface operational logs and command output in a new always-available UI context and depends on unresolved dashboard binding decisions.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Boundary Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the dashboard substrate first, and implement these widgets only after maintainers approve the log/output disclosure and binding rules.

options.title: Narrow To Read-Only Existing Data
options.body: Permit a focused follow-up only for existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded output, excluding new command execution, generic command bindings, or stream capabilities.

options.title: Defer Bundled Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context and ask for external plugin or API-gap work until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Boundary Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the dashboard substrate first, and implement these widgets only after maintainers approve the log/output disclosure and binding rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history points to `steipete` on the relevant Control UI, log-tail, terminal, and plugin-tab surfaces, and this decision needs product/security ownership.
